originality.rationale: Kai (2026) primary introduces full three-parameter affine model but explicitly confines attraction result to small invariant annulus and does not claim global uniqueness. Published calibrated shape-conjugacy result has bounded exterior collar and B_i^0<0, cannot satisfy candidate global monotone-angular criterion. Earlier regular-polygon Filippov result takes mu=0 and sliding convention, while candidate proves no zero-shear polygon can have B_i^0>=0 on all sides because sum_i p_i.e_i=-sum||e_i||^2/2<0. No implication from these other results to sheared, all-plane, positive-transversal crossing regime.

value.rationale: Establishes a sharp, nonempty computable global-positivity regime in a natural previously local-only polygonal oscillator model. Its shear necessity is a structural obstruction; the whole punctured-plane basin, uniqueness, rate and Floquet formula make it a meaningful exact global dynamics classification, not parameter relabeling.

limitations: Radially star-shaped simple polygons, positive angular sector widths and specified no-reset crossing; origin excluded.
No necessity of global attraction when the sharp angular-positivity criterion fails; only necessity of pointwise positive traversal.
